stories.title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said the Pentagon will not livestream the firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan, reversing an earlier plan after public and bipartisan criticism.
